project_context.company_name: My Labels Packaging Materials Manufacturing L.L.C.

fonts.heading: Cabinet Grotesk
fonts.install_instructions: Import these from Google Fonts or Fontshare in index.css

rules.hierarchy: H1 up to text-5xl/6xl with tracking-tighter, H2 text-4xl. Body text-base. Overlines/labels text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em].
rules.weight_contrast: Use font-black for major headings, font-normal for body.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look): Expose the skeleton for product catalogs using border-collapse or tight grid borders (border-border/40). Solid white surfaces for containers.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using border-gray-200. No heavy glassmorphism for this B2B site.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use sharp, small offset shadows or hard borders instead of soft diffuse shadows.

components.buttons: Sharp rectangular (rounded-none) or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm) buttons. Primary CTA must be Brand Red. Hover states -translate-y-1.
components.cards: Flat cards with 1px border. No default shadows.
components.navigation: Sticky top bar, solid white background, border-b. NO transparent nav.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Inputs and Textareas, strip 'Vercel-look', apply square corners and Red focus ring.

layouts.hero: Split layout or an aggressive left-aligned aesthetic. Darkened image of Dubai skyline/printing press on one side, bold text + Red CTA on the left.
layouts.products_grid: Bento Grid Protocol. High density grid for data, slightly looser (gap-8) for marketing products.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (py-24 or py-32 for sections, p-8 for containers). Avoid cramped layouts.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Buttons lift slightly.

accessibility.contrast: Red (#E60000) on White ensures APCA compliance. Ensure text on images has dark overlays.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

image_urls.description: Industrial printing press showing technical precision

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React (.js/.jsx) pages. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
Integrate a floating WhatsApp button fixed to the bottom right (using +971 561159894) that stays above content.
Implement the 'Why Choose Us' or 'Clients' section using a slow, seamless react-fast-marquee.
Build an RFQ (Request a Quote) section with Shadcn forms. Make sure forms use strict grid layouts.
Apply data-testid to every button, form input, and nav link (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-btn').
Ensure Header has a solid background. Never use transparent header backgrounds over content.
Follow the B2B industrial aesthetics: stark white/gray base, bold red interactions, high contrast.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layout contrast rather than just shadows.
Do not apply universal transition: all. Use specific targeted transitions.
Never use emoji characters as icons.
